errors.description: identifiers is missing, empty, over 100 entries, or contains an entry with no colon or an empty issuer or value.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

total.description: Total matching contributors. Present on the first page only.

identifiers.description: Identifier pairs to match, repeated once per pair as `issuer:value` (`?identifiers=isbn13:9780441478125&identifiers=isni:0000000121032683`). Each pair splits on its first colon, so a value may contain colons. Duplicate pairs are collapsed; matching compares issuer and value exactly, without normalization.

limit.description: Maximum number of contributors to return.

offset.description: Number of matching contributors to skip.

description: Resolve catalog contributors by exact (issuer, value) identifiers. Read-only, anonymous, and served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables; the catalog's own publisher records are the only results, so a miss is an empty page rather than an error.
